text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! It's a chuuurch!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Evacuation to safe zone—successful. We are no longer at risk from the lightning storm or any potential landslides.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm really, really sorry! I'm to blame for all this…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: All parties are uninjured. We have successfully obtained a place for refuge. What seems to be the problem?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We were so close to getting injured… All because I wanted to go on a picnic…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, this bento lunch is amazing! Look, it's got little versions of us running across a field!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I thought it'd be nice if we could be like this, so I made it in food form.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You're right, look how smiley we are! It's just like us!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but it's not… The real us aren't in a field, and we're not having a picnic…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm having tons of fun! I've never had a sleepover in a church before!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Me too. This is making for a very interesting experience.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If you think today's gone all wrong, we can always try again.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Cause I wanna hang out with you looots and lots, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: In the spring, we can go see the cherry blossoms bloom!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And in the summer, we can go swimming in the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: May we also go out to observe the autumn foliage together? There is a mission I'm interested in—"Sweet Potato Baking."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: If we fail, we can always try again. We can also pray to the Three Goddesses if you are nervous.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I will accompany you whatever the cause. After all, I'm your friend.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That goes for me too! We'll have fun over and over again, 'cause I'll aaalways be your friend!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara… Bourbon…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Will you make snowmen with me in the winter?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Do you really want to be around… me?

text_block_list.name: Urara & Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much… I promise…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We'll stay friends…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Forever.
